note: [agent-bulk] Small clean event: ONE shower in scope, 4021 (129.7 MeV, 4 seg, pdg 11, len 11.3); the other five shower nodes are 0.3-2.9 MeV single-segment orphans below the 20 MeV cut (34017, 28011, 32015, 30013, 27010) and I did not scan them as objects. event_half_span_cm 58.9, so the r95 vertex sweep is already close in - no --vtx-span re-capture. VERTEX IS GOOD, judged from vtx-az-055-el+20 and vtx-az+065-el+20: three cluster-4 segments touch the main vertex at 0.00 cm - 4022 (pdg 13, 31.6 cm, the incoming/outgoing track), 4018 (pdg 211, 2.7 cm) and the shower seed 4021 - and both prongs 4022 and 4018 are correctly left UNOWNED while the EM fan hangs off the same point. CLUSTERING: on shw4021-az+085-el+20 the yellow member set is a clean chain straight down the orange axis - 4021 at the X, then 33016 (11.6 cm / 4.7 deg), 31014 (17.4 cm / 13.3 deg), then 29012 (59.9 cm / 10.5 deg). shw4021-acc shows four member squares and NOT ONE non-member circle in the plotted range; every non-member is beyond 23 deg. There is no grey (unowned) charge anywhere in this event - every fragment is claimed by some node - so the strong under-clustering case does not arise. THE ONE READING I WOULD LET THE OWNER REVERSE, and it is close: 34017 (4.4 cm) sits at 24.2 cm / 28.6 deg, i.e. on the same chain, between accepted members at 17.4 cm and 59.9 cm, and on shw4021-az+085-el+20 it looks like the next link, drawn in its own orange rather than grey. The 'it is owned by a neighbour' objection (correction 11) is WEAK here, because that neighbour is a 1-segment 2.9 MeV orphan node, not a competing shower. I still call 4021 correct because (i) 28.6 deg is outside the 25 deg pass-1 step while all four accepted members are within 13.4 deg, so the reconstruction's angle cut is being applied consistently, not capriciously - it also let in 29012 at 60 cm because that one is at 10.5 deg; (ii) 24 cm at 28.6 deg is 11.5 cm transverse, about 1.2 Moliere radii, i.e. marginal shower content; (iii) in the az-055 projection it does NOT sit on the axis, so the chain reading is one-projection-dependent; and (iv) it is 2.9 MeV out of 129.7. I did NOT mark it, deliberately - marking it would turn a 2% effect into a flat IN. Reconciliation check done (correction 11): 4021's nseg is 4 and exactly four segments carry owner 4021, so no segment is silently a member of two showers here. No pi0 in this event and none proposed: the only other EM objects are the sub-3 MeV orphans, so there is no second gamma to pair.
